_readme: Baseline for test_perf_budget.js (PLAN_lg_performance_2026-11-08.md, Part 1). To accept growth on purpose run `node perf_budget_measure.js --reason "<one line: why>"` — it rewrites these numbers and adds a history line. Line numbers are where each interval was when measured; the key is what matches.

shortIntervals.purpose: FAMCFG_GUARD 'Loading your family…' screen retries every 20 s — only when family-config.js failed to load (no boot)
codeVersion reload-when-idle retry — only while a new deploy is waiting for the device to be idle
new-week reload-when-idle retry — only while a week change is waiting for the device to be idle
School-schedule drag auto-scroll near the top/bottom edge — only while a finger is dragging
kiosk-routines idle check (back to 'all' after no touch) — only on a kiosk-routines device
celebration points count-up animation — a second or two, then cleared
brain-break alarm repeat tone — only while a finished brain break is ringing (stops after 60 s)
brain-break countdown display — only while a brain break is running
🍳 kitchen prep countdown text tick — ALWAYS ON from boot (30 s), cheap: text only
roadmap book chip waits for library.js to load (150 ms × 60 max), then clears
Envirothon test clock — only while a station test is open
Envirothon flashcard timer (100 ms) — only while a flashcard is shown
TTS voice-list wait (some webOS builds never fire voiceschanged) — clears when voices load
Match game clock — only while a round is running
Match game clock restarted after a gate closes — only while a round is running
check-in (ck) session timer display — clears itself when the card is gone
ABC Train levels 3–5: edge-scroll of the track/page while a car is being dragged (started on pointerdown, cleared on drop/cancel; idle otherwise)
Math Sprint 60 s run timer (200 ms) — only while a sprint runs
Mental-math says tick (250 ms) — only while a run is going
worksheet sprint live timer — only while a sprint sheet is timing
🔔 bbWatch — ALWAYS ON from boot, every 1 s on every device: watches every brain break (biggest battery cost of the list)
Envirothon console mock-run clock — only while a team mock run is open (moved with CPMOCK to classes.js, 2026-11-08)
Iowa test timer (EIC) — only during a timed Iowa run
Brain Dump round clock — only while a round is playing (moved with BRAINDUMP to games.js, 2026-11-08)
Beat-the-clock round clock — stops itself when the round ends, parks or leaves the screen (moved with BEAT to games.js, 2026-11-08)
Categories round clock — only while a round is playing (moved with CATS to games.js, 2026-11-08)
Name-All countdown — only while a round is playing (moved with NAMEALL to games.js, 2026-11-08)
print window watcher (5 s) — revokes the blob URL once the print window closes
